components.semantics: Use button for actions and a for navigation.
Use the landmark or sectioning element appropriate to the content.
Associate every control with a label and hints or errors through aria-describedby.
Prefer the native dialog element with an accessible name.
components.enhancement: data-pwf-dialog-open and data-pwf-dialog-close connect controls without inline script.

components.semantics: Use tablist, tab, and tabpanel roles with aria-controls and labelled panels.
components.enhancement: Arrow keys, Home, and End select tabs. Without JavaScript, panels remain visible.

components.semantics: Use caption and scoped header cells; the wrapper only provides horizontal overflow.
Place the visual loader inside an element with role=status and meaningful text.
Messages use polite status announcements; danger messages use alert.
components.enhancement: The API inserts text with textContent and never accepts HTML.

components.semantics: Use visible text and an appropriate status or alert role; color and icons only supplement meaning.
Choose an article or section for content cards and an anchor for a fully navigable card.
Use native details and summary for collapsible content and simple contextual dropdowns.
Wrap pagination in a named nav, use list markup, and mark the current destination with aria-current.
Compose one banner, one main landmark, and one contentinfo landmark around complete page content.
Every destination is an ordinary link; aria-current identifies the current page or location.
Use a section linked to the page heading and keep status text readable without relying on color.
Use an anchor for page destinations and preserve a descriptive accessible name.
Expose large settings groups as linkable sections on a complete page with native form controls.
Use a native named dialog for transient tools; keep every navigational result as an ordinary anchor and link quick settings to the complete settings page.
components.enhancement: data-pwf-overlay-placement selects search, top-end launcher, or bottom quick-settings geometry without changing dialog behavior.

components.semantics: Keep the underlying region natively scrollable and give the scrollbar thumb an accessible name plus aria-controls.
components.enhancement: Pointer drag, track clicks, vertical wheel input, resize updates, and horizontal scrollbar keyboard commands enhance the same overflow viewport.

components.semantics: Keep every destination as an anchor and expose pin state through a separate button with aria-pressed.
components.enhancement: Pinning works in memory by default and persists only when the application injects a Storage-compatible adapter.

components.semantics: Render allowlisted Markdown into an article inside the application shell and retain a direct source link as the failure fallback.
components.enhancement: The safe renderer creates DOM nodes without innerHTML and emits pwf:markdown-ready or pwf:markdown-error.
